| Gate | Invariant | Measurable threshold |
|---|---|---|
| **Correctness** | Deterministic target logits and token acceptance | On a fixed 128-prompt suite: top-1 token match ≥ 99.9% vs CPU reference; max logit L2 error ≤ 1e-3; MTP accepted-token sequence identical to CPU reference for 100% of prompts; no NaN/Inf. |
| **Correctness** | Correct KV/recurrent rollback across partial MTP acceptance | After forced partial accept/reject cycles: KV cache checksum matches CPU reference; next-token distribution error ≤ 1e-3; no state drift over 1000 decode steps. |
| **Performance** | Preserve CPU advantage and MTP benefit | CPU+MTP draft-1 must remain ≥ 1.10× faster than CPU baseline. Vulkan exact-row kernel must be ≥ 1.05× faster than CPU for N=2 Q2_K decode; N=4 must not regress > 2% vs CPU. MTP orchestration overhead ≤ 5% of per-token time. |
| **Stability** | No shared-LPDDR contention regression | Sustained 30-min mixed CPU/Vulkan run: p95 token latency regression ≤ 3% vs CPU-only; no OOM; no device reset; memory growth ≤ 1% over run. |
| **Fallback coverage** | Generic Vulkan path remains safe | Fallback triggers for unsupported shape, dtype, device, or kernel failure in 100% of injected fault tests; fallback output matches CPU reference within correctness thresholds; fallback latency penalty ≤ 20% vs CPU baseline. |
